name: Interception
summary: Reaction: reduce damage to an ally within 5 feet by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus.

benefits.name: Interception
benefits.summary: Reaction when a creature hits someone within 5 ft of you: reduce the damage by 1d10 + PB.
benefits.text: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 5 feet of you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage the target takes by 1d10 plus your Proficiency Bonus. You must be holding a Shield or a Simple or Martial weapon to use this Reaction.
